name: fatia-mcp
description: Prepare models for Bambu Studio from Claude -- STL and 3MF tools, CLI slicing, 3MF tuning, a print-settings knowledge base and a Blender bridge. It never contacts or controls a printer.

bambu_model.title: Printer model
bambu_model.description: Selects the machine profile to slice for; G-code for the wrong model can damage the printer when it is printed. One of: p1s, p1p, p2s, x1c, x1e, a1, a1mini, h2d, h2dpro, h2s, h2c, x2d.

blender_mcp_command.title: Blender MCP executable (optional)
blender_mcp_command.description: Executable for your Blender MCP server, for example the full path to uvx. Leave empty to use the other tools without Blender.

blender_mcp_args.title: Blender MCP arguments (optional)
blender_mcp_args.description: JSON array of arguments for the executable, for example ["blender-mcp"]. Enable the matching MCP addon inside Blender before editing.

slicer_path.title: Slicer executable path (optional)
slicer_path.description: Full path to the Bambu Studio (or compatible) slicer executable, if not in the default location.
